text:
Aisha: FYI — Prospect (LargeMed) requested full pen-test artifacts + external vuln-scan output for procurement and security review. They want raw scan exports, remediation evidence, and a short remediation timeline to include in their vendor risk ticket. Can we assemble a package today? Link they gave: https://vendor-portal.example.com/request/LM-2026

Jon: Got it. Which formats do they need? Typical asks: Nessus/Qualys CSVs, consolidated findings spreadsheet, evidence folder with before/after screenshots or patch IDs, and an attestation PDF. Also need the scan checksums and S3/transfer details for them to validate integrity.

Priya: Please make sure we redact any customer PII from screenshots/logs before sharing. For the remediation timeline they usually expect: immediate critical fixes (48-72h), high (1–2 weeks), medium/low (scheduled next sprint). Ask them if they require an independent re-scan or a signed verification from our security team.

Aisha: Thanks — agreed on redaction. I'll provide the procurement contact's acceptance criteria. Quick plan: Jon to export raw scan CSVs + consolidated spreadsheet; Priya to assemble attestation + note on redaction and verify CVE list; I'll draft a 2-week remediation cadence with owners. Can @Jon and @Priya ack? :thumbsup:

Jon: Ack. I'll export the Qualys/Nessus CSVs, run a quick dedupe, and upload to the staging S3 path below. Will include a CSV of CVE IDs and CVSS scores. S3 path (private):
```
s3://redwood-sec-evidence/LM-2026/2105009999/
```
I'll put an MD5 manifest: `manifest-md5.txt` with checksums and include sha256 of the main archive.

Priya: Ack. I'll prepare the attestation PDF and a short remediation summary that maps each finding to an owner in ENG and proposed ETA. Also confirm we won't be exposing internal IPs or full stack traces. I recommend we propose a 10 business day remediation window with weekly checkpoints; call out any blockers that may need customer coordination (e.g., certificate rotation, private subnet work).

Aisha: Perfect. For procurement they asked if we can include evidence of fix verification — screenshots + post-scan results. If we can get a re-scan scheduled after fixes, include "post-fix scan" artifacts. I'll schedule a 15-min call with the buyer and include this package beforehand.

sec-bot: Upload complete: `s3://redwood-sec-evidence/LM-2026/2105009999/scan-exports.zip` (sha256: f3b2...8a9). Permission: redwood-sales + redwood-security only.

Jon: Uploaded manifest and `scan-exports.zip`. I also added `fix-evidence/` with before_after_{ticket}.png screenshots for the high/critical items.

Priya: Received. I'll generate the attestation and a one-page remediation timeline PDF and drop in `attestation/` by EOD. Aisha — will you confirm the customer wants a signed attestation or is a stamped/printed PDF fine?

Aisha: I'll confirm with procurement now and update thread. If they need signatures, we have a standard sign-off template we can use. Thanks everyone — this should keep the vendor risk review moving. :rocket:
